_help: Add objects to a slot to show a paid placement. Fields: name, url (https, with UTM tags), headline, body, cta. featured_category/use_case_sidebar take categories; featured_tool takes blueprints (slugs) and/or categories; run_for_less_tile also takes big + unit (e.g. '$20', 'free credit'). Empty slot = house ad pointing to /advertise/ (featured_tool and run_for_less_tile show nothing when empty). Everything is labeled Sponsored automatically.
